title: Extract Engram authority ledger and lifecycle tests from oversized modules
outcome: The immediate-revocation work has grown src/session_crud.rs beyond the Rust module review threshold and src/tests/engram_host_adapter.rs far beyond the test-module threshold. Extract store identity, retired-authority ledger merge/confirm/migration/ingress invariants into a dedicated module with a provenance/ownership header, and move focused authority rotation/ledger/race tests into dedicated test modules without changing behavior.
acceptance: Dedicated production and test modules own the authority-ledger concerns; session_crud.rs contains only thin orchestration call sites; module headers document fail-closed hash blocking, unconfirmed retention, confirmed bounds, and ownership; the full Rust suite remains green.
